title: The March To Life
author: William Saville
content:
Fate I fear,
A written script,
Head Down,
And all tight-lipped.
March To death,
From life's beginning,
Small victories,
Are not winning.
War after war,
Filled with pirates' plunder,
Demons masked,
The devil slumbers.
Just beneath the surface,
A glowing smile forms,
On we march,
For ignorance is the norm.
Brows sweat with backs aching,
"Work harder," they say.
"You're not tired or disabled,
You're just faking!"
Nose to the dirt,
And they'll protect you,
Smile in your face,
And swear it's true.
Steal your wages and retirement,
Send your children to war,
Take away resources,
Leaving all destitute and poor.
They turn us against each other,
With a sea of lies,
Making it so we do not care,
When our sibling dies.
Because they have turned them into the enemy,
They have turned brothers, siblings, and sisters,
Against one another,
Fighting until it festers like blisters.
Nose to the dirt and work hard,
So the senator can get a new vacation home,
When a young mother can barely make a living,
And a veteran has no home.
America is a continent not a country.
We try to make ourselves something we're not.
Because it's shameful to be poor,
Then to hate people by a lot.
To scream in the face of an employee,
To call the police on people for living,
To scream at a Transgender person trying to pee,
But it's shameful to be giving.
We have come so far,
Grown in so many ways against strife,
But we need to stop marching towards death,
We need to march towards a better life.
